title: Scrolling Through ZYN.com
lessons: The player opens ZYN.com to look around and is stopped by registration and age verification before reaching the product pages.
The player scrolls past the most-recirculated ZYN meme format before sleep: someone holding a tin aloft, camera-forward, like it is being presented rather than just opened.

text: In bed, you type ZYN.com into your phone to see what flavors exist. You do not get to the flavors. You get a form.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: I just wanted to see what flavors there are.

entry-first-2.speaker: COUNSEL
text: Before any product is shown, the site requires proof that you are at least twenty-one and already use nicotine. I am aware you were expecting a picture of a tin.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: You brought a lawyer to an age gate.

entry-first-4.speaker: COUNSEL
text: I was retained before the page loaded.

entry-first-5.speaker: PLAYER
text: What exactly are they verifying?

entry-first-6.speaker: COUNSEL
text: Identity and age, through a third party. The company's own filings say the check may compare what you type against government records. I would not describe it as a birthday dropdown.

choice-first.speaker: COUNSEL
text: You have been holding the phone above your face for some time. Your position, for the record?

choices.text: Fine. I actually like that they check instead of using a birthday dropdown.
That's a lot of personal information just to browse a website.
If I have to register before I can even look, I'm leaving.

first-1.speaker: COUNSEL
text: The record will reflect that you prefer a meaningful age gate over a decorative one.

first-1-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: That is the least romantic sentence anyone has ever said to me.

first-1-2.speaker: COUNSEL
text: I am comfortable with that characterization.

first-2.speaker: COUNSEL
text: It is. Keeping people out requires knowing who they are. An honor-system date field keeps nobody out. I do not enjoy either sentence.

first-2-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: So the friction is intentional.

first-2-2.speaker: COUNSEL
text: Correct.

first-3.speaker: COUNSEL
text: Then you never reach the product page. No further action is required. Goodnight.
You scroll past the same clip a third time before sleep: someone holding a tin aloft, camera-forward, like it is being presented rather than just opened.

entry-return-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Why does everyone film themselves holding the tin up like that? Like it's being elevated.

entry-return-2.speaker: COUNSEL
text: People did that before anyone filmed it. Showing the tin to the room, to the camera, to the group chat, before the pouch is in. The video did not invent the gesture. It found it.

entry-return-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: So the company did not storyboard the version where people treat the tin like a holy relic.

entry-return-4.speaker: COUNSEL
text: No. There is no brand asset in that clip. Users made it, users spread it, and no one at the company approved it because no one at the company was asked.

entry-return-5.speaker: PLAYER
text: It is midnight and I have watched it three times.

entry-return-6.speaker: COUNSEL
text: That outcome required no advertising spend. I note it without satisfaction.

choice-return.speaker: COUNSEL
text: You are about to watch it a fourth time. Before you do.

choices.text: It's funny because the gesture is real. People actually hold it up like that.
Free reverence from a meme you didn't make is still free reverence.
I don't want a nicotine tin to be the thing my group chat treats as sacred.

return-1.speaker: COUNSEL
text: Recognition of the bit noted. Put the phone down before the fifth viewing.

return-1-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: You are the worst person to be told to put my phone down by.

return-1-2.speaker: COUNSEL
text: The advice does not require me to be the ideal messenger.

return-2.speaker: COUNSEL
text: Correct. Nobody paid for it, and it is still working. I would prefer that were not true. It is true.

return-3.speaker: COUNSEL
text: That reaction is available to you regardless of what the format finds funny. Scroll past it. Sleep.
